ward.summary: Matunga, Sion, Wadala (ward F/N) used ₹94.1 lakh of its ₹1.05 crore budget, or 90%, staying within budget across 150 jobs. Repairs that failed within 30 days came to ₹21.3 lakh; the redo rate of 25% is in line with the expected 24%, and completing 43% of jobs on time is in line with the expected 46%. Given the ward's flood index of 0.90, keeping repairs in place is harder. Nine jobs are listed for review, and 37 jobs, worth ₹22.2 lakh, were paid on roads under warranty. Of 39 open issues costing ₹14.0 lakh, the remaining ₹10.9 lakh covers 25, so it falls short. Eastern Express Highway waterlogging and drain overflow should be funded first.
